cohort: 3,078 consecutive pregnant women who experienced prenatal care and delivery of a live singleton neonate
finding: Obese women without GDM face a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, such as pre-eclampsia and cesarean section, compared to women with supervised GDM and non-obese women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in groups with obesity.
birth_weight: Neonates in the group with obesity without GDM were heavier than those in the group with GDM without obesity
